description: Update or delete an existing limit order. Set isDelete=true to cancel (no other fields needed). An update replaces amount, triggerPrice and TP/SL together, so all four are required.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

amount.description: New amount in raw units (required unless isDelete)

isDelete.description: Set true to cancel the order

lossPercent.description: New SL %, whole number under 100, '0' = none (required unless isDelete)

profitPercent.description: New TP %, whole number, '0' = none; buy orders only, sell orders ignore it (required unless isDelete)

triggerPrice.description: New trigger price in USD (required unless isDelete)

name: update_order
